batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b R Bhatia

batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: c DB Das b SP Narine

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c DP Nannes b DJ Bravo

balls.text: errs in length and bowls a low full-toss, that's what Dhoni was looking for and he spoils Balaji's over with a slap over cow corner
and another full delivery wide outside off, the batsman drives it down the ground to long off
yorker is back in vogue! Full and wide outside off, Dhoni can only push it as far as cover point
bowls a yorker wide outside off, Dhoni goes for the helicopter, but just ends up jamming it over Balaji's head, he comes back for a couple by the time long on gets to the ball

another low full toss outside off, Dhoni plays a powerful drive to deep cover and calls for a couple straight away. Das sends in a flat throw from the deep and Raina was always struggling. He dives in but is still short!
he bowls it full on the off stump, Raina whips it to deep midwicket
he bowls a high full toss outside off, the batsman punches it to deep point for a single
it's another full delivery outside off, Raina slices it past point and there is no one in the deep
full delivery wide outside off, Dhoni goes hard at it, but can only drive it as far as long off
he bowls it full from round the stumps, the batsman jams it to midwicket
bowls a slower low full toss on the middle stump! the batsman tries to flick it to deep square leg, but gets a leading edge to long on
he bowls a high full-toss from round the wicket, it comes in with the angle and the batsman tucks it straight to short third-man

that extra ball has cost KKR a boundary! It was a good delivery actually, full yorker outside off. Dhoni, however, smashes it past the umpire with a lot of power, no chance for the fielders in the deep
another good delivery! It's a yorker wide outside off, the batsman punches it down to long on
he bowls a slower short delivery outside off, the batsman has to wait a touch before playing a pull to deep midwicket
he tries to go wide outside off, bowls it along the wide marker and the umpire stretches his arms
bowls a short slower delivery outside off, the batsman pulls it to deep midwicket without much timing
bowls a fuller delivery on off stump, the batsman plays a whippy drive in the gap at deep midwicket for a couple
he bowls a full yorker wide outside off, the batsman jams it out to point for a single
he attempts a yorker, but it's a low full toss that the batsman flicks to deep midwicket for a couple
he bowls it short of length and on the body, Dhoni goes for a pull but gets beaten as the ball goes under his bat.. The keeper doesn't collect it cleanly and the batsmen steal a single
he bowls it full on the stumps, Dhoni blocks it out to mid-off, thinks about a single then sends Raina back. A direct hit comes in from Bhatia, but Raina has just made it with a dive
short of length outside off, the batsman slaps it to long on for a single
he bowls a slower delivery outside off, Raina goes down on his knee and plays an inside out aerial drive over extra cover.. Macca fields near the boundary
bowls a fuller delivery on the pads and Raina just flicks it to deep backward square leg boundary.. A poor delivery to start
he bowls it full on off stump, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
he has picked out the fielder at deep midwicket! He got a shortish delivery and he is too tired to run at the moment, pulls it hard without much power straight into the hands of the fielder
bowls it short and the batsman shapes to play the pull, but the ball keeps going away from him after pitching. He has to drag it to backward square leg
he bowls a full toss and the batsman obliges by smashing it past the non-striker for another boundary
he makes room and plays an inside out shot over extra cover to a turning delivery
flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it to long on
he doesn't want to run, he is struggling with his running! So he chooses to smash this flat delivery and gets a whole lot of bat on it, it sails over the cow corner
this time he takes a couple as he hits a powerful drives to the right of deep midwicket
he comes forward and punches the angled delivery to deep midwicket
he clears his front foot out and tries to whack it over midwicket, but gets an inside edge to deep backward square leg
quicker delivery on the stumps, Raina dabs it to short fine leg for a single
he bowls a full toss on the middle stump line, Hussey goes for a reverse sweep and gets into a bit of a tangle, taps it to short third man

oye! Macca makes his presence felt! It was just a nice little punch to long off. Macca has to wait for the ball, because it is hit softly towards him, but he lets it go through his legs and it's a four! It's the kind of mistake toddlers make when they are still learning to get their hand and eye coordination working...
full and flighted on the pads, the batsman whips it to deep square leg
slightly short and turning away from Hussey, he punches it to cover
pushed through outside off, turns away a touch, the batsman cuts it straight to point
six no. 100 for Raina! He makes slight room and scoops it over extra cover, it just clears the rope
slightly short in length and Hussey loves playing the pull shot! He finds the gap at deep square leg with perfection
he takes a forward stride and drives it down to long off for a single
goes down on his knee again, but Bhatia bowls a high full-toss wide outside off. Hussey brings it from there down to deep backward square leg
he shapes do repeat the shot, but Bhatia bowls it wide outside off! Hussey, though, was quick to readjust and he cuts it through the gap at backward point
he goes down on his knee even before the ball is released and scoop-slaps it over short fine.. The ball slows down towards the boundary
he bowls a slower delivery on a length outside off, the batsman punches it to long on
bowls it full and wide outside off, Hussey comes forward and drives it to wide long on for a couple
he gets a length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to cover
attempts a short delivery and Hussey hooks it fine on the leg side! Short fine leg fielder just watches it go
he bowls a slower low full toss outside off which Raina punches to long off for a single
he bowls a yorker on off stump, the batsman punches it to midwicket
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to pull it, but it's not that short! He ends up dragging it towards square leg
he bowls a low full toss and Hussey hits it straight back, towards Raina, who acrobatically avoids the ball. it goes to long on for a single
and another good slow yorker! Not much the batsman can do about it, except block it
he bowls it full on the off stump line, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
he comes forward and drives the fuller delivery down to long off
bowls length outside off, the batsman stays in the crease and punches it to long off

caught at deep midwicket! Bhatia does it again! he bowls a slower legcutter on the leg stump, Saha, who has been playing very well, tries to go big over deep midwicket. But he gets too much under the delivery and hits it really high. Morgan waits ages in the deep for the ball to come down, then gobbles it up
he goes for a similar slog sweep again, this time gets some bat to it, played to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat
goes for a wild slog but he is no where near the delivery! Narine bowled if flat and quick outside off and the batsman is beaten
tosses it up on the middle stump, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to midwicket with soft hands
shorter again and wide too outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to deep extra cover
it's the conventional offspinner, but it is slightly short. Hussey waits on the back foot and cuts it to deep point
pushes it through wide outside off and shorter in length, the batsman stays on the back foot and flat bats it to wide long on
full and slower outside off, Hussey goes aerial and finds the gap at extra cover perfectly
fuller delivery on the pads, it was a cutter again, the batsman clears his front foot out and drives it to deep midwicket
keeps it tight around off stump, the batsman drives it down the ground to long off
length delivery on the middle stump, the batsman stays in the crease and punches it to wide long on
similar delivery, this time the batsman cuts it to deep backward point
slower delivery, but it is slightly wide outside off, Hussey cuts it hard to the left of point, who makes a half-stop (Gambhir there). They scamper through for a couple
and another fifty for Hussey! He flicks a length delivery on the pads to deep midwicket and brings up his fourth half-century this season
he bowls it full on the off stump, the batsman blocks it out to mid off
short delivery around the throat area, but Saha has already shown that he is keen to play the pull and hook, he swivels and sends this over short fine leg fielder, almost all the way
another slower delivery on the pads, the batsman tucks it to deep square leg
it's in Hussey's arc and it goes deep into the stands at deep midwicket! Kallis bowled it slightly slower and on a length, ideal recipe for  his kind of shot
bowls a length delivery outside off, slightly slower, the batsman comes forward and opens the face to run it down to third man
more slower stuff from Bhatia, this time it is on off stump, the batsman punches it to extra cover
another slower length delivery on off stump, the batsman punches it down the ground to long on
bowls it really full on off stump, the batsman digs it out to the left of the bowler
bowls a slow legcutter on the middle stump, Saha comes forward and whips it to deep midwicket
slightly short of length outside off, the batsman stays in the crease and cuts it behind point
he bowls a length delivery on the off stump, the batsman punches it down to long on
bowls a quick bouncer under which Hussey ducks well in time
short of length quick delivery, the batsman hops on his toes and dabs it to square leg
he attempts a slower delivery, but Saha spots it and comes forward to launch it over long-off, comfortably clears the boundary
he picks up the shortish length early and is quickly into the position to play a pull, slaps it in front of square
a misfield at point allows the batsmen to come back for three. It was short of length on off and the batsmen punched it straight to the fielder who is not able to stop it cleanly
the batsman greets him with a charge down the pitch and whacks it past midwicket, all along the ground
and another short delivery, it comes a little quicker on to Hussey as he pulls it to deep midwicket
it's a loopy delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to cover
slows it down this time, he tosses it up on the middle stump, the batsman comes forward to defend
short delivery, it was the carrom ball, but it was too short and Hussey dispatches it to the deep square leg boundary with ease
this time, it's a proper edge! The batsman was slightly surprised with the turn and bounce on that, edges it past slip for a boundary
tries to drives a flat delivery on the up, gets a thick outside edge to point
another length delivery on the stumps, this time the batsman defends it to the leg side
he hits the rope on the full! Beautifully timed shot! For a second it looked like he had mistimed it to mid-off, but it went all the way. Very nice on the up drive off a length delivery
length delivery wide outside off, the batsman throws his bat, but makes no connection

fuller delivery outside off this time and Saha drives it hard to mid-off. Hussey was keen on a single and went halfway down the pitch, the throw comes in and would have found Hussey short had that hit
slightly short of length outside off, but Saha plays a premeditated swivel shot and finds the gap at deep backward square leg
length delivery on off stump, Saha brings his bat down with a nice flourish and smashes his Bengal team mate over mid-on
he bowls a length delivery wide outside off, Saha carefully watches it go through
comes down the pitch again, Balaji' response is to bowl a cutter which ends up being a low full toss outside off, Hussey carves it through extra cover
back of length, a touch slower outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to cover point
this one is edged, but there is no one at slip! He slashed at a length delivery and the ball runs down fine for a boundary
this time he gets under it properly! He charges down and gets under the length ball, drives it over extra cover
gives some width with a length delivery, Hussey tries to punch it on the up, but ends up pushing it back to the bowler as the ball comes slow off the deck
he bowls it on length outside off, Hussey charges down the pitch and tries to go inside out, but gets a thick inside edge past the leg stump for a couple
he flicks it down to fine leg to keep the strike
better delivery, it's on a length just outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends it to cover point
strays on to the pads and pays the price, the batsman stays in the crease and flicks it fine on the leg side
another tight back of length delivery on the stumps, Hussey defends it off the back foot
goes for a pull as soon as he sees the shortish length, but the ball doesn't bounce that much, goes over the stumps as the batsman is beaten
back of length delivery on off, the batsman defends it to point off the back foot
slower and tossed up outside off, the batsman taps it to backward point for a single
full and flat on off stump, the batsman drives it straight to cover
and again, played with soft hands and to deep midwicket
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and drives it through midwicket with a roll of wrists
comes forward to a flighted delivery and drives it down to long on
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman defends it to midwicket
he bowls another yorker from wide of the crease, the batsman can only block it to the leg side..
another super yorker on the leg stump, the batsman can only dig it out on the off side
he bowls a full toss wide outside off, everyone looks around to see what the umpire thinks of it, but Morris gets away with it
he bowls it full wide outside off and Pathan can only drive it down to long off
he bowls another quick low full toss on the pads which Morgan is only able to punch hard to deep midwicket
he bowls a super yorker from round the wicket, the batsman can only dig it out to the bowler
he bowls a full slower delivery on the pads, Morgan can only chip it to long on off the toe-end of the bat for a single
he gets a full toss from round the wicket and he flicks it straight to deep backward square leg! He could have put it anywhere really
another good yorker by Bravo again, the batsman digs it out to mid off for a single
he bowls a full toss wide outside off, another extra

he moves outside leg stump and punches it hard to the fielder at mid-off! He calls for a single, but it went quickly to Hussey, who gets rid of it quickly too. Hussey hits the stumps at non-striker's end and Bisla goes for a brilliant 92.. Some innings this was by him..
gets his yorker right this time, the batsman punches it down to long off for a single
he bowls a slower delivery which Morgan wanted to sweep, but he misses and the ball is down the leg side
oye lovely! he plays  a reverse paddle to a delivery outside leg stump and Dhoni can just watch it go between him and the short third man fielder
he gets a full delivery and gets a nice little tickle past Dhoni for another boundary
he bowls a full and wide delivery outside off and Bisla, who was backing away too far, is not able to get any bat to it
oye! This is a big hit! He moves outside leg stump and pulls a short delivery that was following him over the deep backward square leg fielder
slightly short of length and Bisla pulls it hard in front of square through midwicket for yet another boundary
bowls a quicker length delivery on the body, the batsman goes for another hoick, but misses the ball and gets hit on the body. They steal a run anyway
wow! he gets a short delivery and he pulls it straight away. For a second it looked like he hadn't timed it, but it just goes over the deep midwicket boundary
he gets a low full toss on the stumps that he punches to the left of deep midwicket and calls for a couple
he again walks across the stumps and paddles a full delivery past his leg stump down to the boundary, wonderfully played
another yorker, this time the batsman flicks it to deep square leg for a single
he bowls another yorker which Morgan somehow digs out!
he bowls a slower delivery, but this is wide down the leg side
he bowls it full on the pads, the batsman pushes it to deep midwicket
he bowls it full and wide outside off and Bisla, who was making room by moving outside leg, stretches and gets some bat on it to guide it over short third man
that was the delivery one shouldn't be bowling at this stage! The length ball outside off stump is hammered by Morgan with a clean hit over long off. It went a long way
he bowls a full yorker wide outside off, Morgan stretches to get to it, but it slips under the bat
he bowls a length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it firmly to mid on and takes off for a single, could have been tight had Jadeja hit the stumps
he walks across the stumps and paddles the length delivery fine on the leg side.
he moves outside leg stump, but Nannes bowls a quick short delivery. Bisla makes no connection in his attempted upper cut
bowls length on off stump, Morgan tries to go over midwicket with a cross-batted slog, mishits it infront of Ashwin at midwicket, who drops an easy chance
he bowls it on a length on the leg stump line, Morgan tries to flog it over midwicket, but gets a top edge that goes to third man
he bowls a full slower delivery, the batsman blocks it out to the right of Bravo, who dives and prevents the single.. Gets hit on the eye by the ball as he falls
bowls a full delivery on the pads, the batsman gets beaten in his flick and runs a leg bye
he makes room by moving outside leg and punches the length delivery, just over the head of Hussey at mid off
he bowls it full as the batsman comes down the pitch, the ball is punched back to the bowler
he walks down the pitch to a short of length delivery, but gets a leading edge to the off side
pushes it through on the off stump line, Morgan sweeps it down to deep backward square leg
he bowls a leg spinner this time (proper back of the hand), the batsman tries to play an inside out drive, but inside edges it to short fine
he bowls it full and flighted, Morgan taps it towards square leg for a single
he goes for a reverse sweep and plays it to deep cover. Settles for a single
another low full toss, this time Bisla goes straight! Just over Morgan's head and down the ground for another boundary
he gets a low full toss on off stump and the batsman swings it towards cow corner, one bounce and four
draws an outside edge off a back of length delivery, it wasn't far from Dhoni, but he remains stuck in his position..Welcome runs
length delivery outside off, slower too, the batsman whacks it across the line to the deep midwicket fielder
bowls a slower length delivery outside off, Bisla waits and punches it hard to deep extra cover for a couple
he bowls it short of length and Morgan waits on the back foot and punches it to long off

caught at short fine! He adds another wicket to his increasing tally, bowls a slower delivery outside off, Kallis goes down on his knee to lap it up over short fine, but because of the lack of pace, just ends up scooping it.. Easy catch for the fielder
bowls a short of length delivery angling in to the batsman, Kallis punches it straight to midwicket
he plays a punchy drive to a full delivery, down to long on
full and flighted on the middle and leg stump line, the batsman drives it hard to long on
he bowls it full on the middle stump, Kallis drives it down to long on with ease
he jumps down the pitch to a full delivery and flicks it to deep midwicket for a single

goes for a reverse sweep off a full delivery, plays it straight to point! The fielder throws it in flat to Dhoni who flicks it on to the stumps. Bisla was a little lazy to get his bat back behind the line. It is a very tight one! It is all about a missing frame! The third umpire is not taking any chances, but unfortunately he hasn't got too many camera angles to support one decision or the other.. He goes for not out..
tossed up delivery on the stumps, Kallis drives it hard to deep midwicket
tries to play a cheeky reverse flick past third man to a widish flat delivery, but makes no connection
he punches this off the front foot to deep extra cover
missed stumping! Dhoni misses an easy chance as he is unable to gather the fuller, quicker delivery.. Kallis has walked down the pitch to play a drive
another quicker delivery, the batsman stays on the back foot and punches it to deep cover for a couple
flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman chops it to point off the back foot
this is over the sight screen! He walks down the pitch and smashes the length delivery from Jajeja with a lot of power
better option! He goes down the pitch and murders the tossed up delivery over cow corner. Huge hit
he moves outside off to a full delivery on the middle stump, he is lucky to connect as he goes for a sweep, plays it to short fine
he comes down the pitch and lofts a flighted delivery without any power or timing, it was going to Raina at midwicket, but he drops it as he runs forward to get to the ball..
flat and short on the off stump, the batsman punches it straight to cover
he bowls this with an exaggerated pause, but Bisla plays a reverse sweep to deep backward point
he flights it up to the batsman, who punches it to long on for a single
quicker delivery on the pads, the batsman tucks it to short fine leg
he goes for a slog sweep, but he is no where near the pitch of the ball, gets beaten as the ball goes under the bat
slower and on a length, the batsman waits and punches it to deep midwicket
he bowls it full and quick on off stump, Bisla pushes it to long off
tossed up delivery on the leg stump, he drives it to long on
he bowls it flat on off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to long off
he stays in the crease and opens the face of the bat late to dab the length delivery to point. They nick a single though
he moves outside leg stump and the bowler follows him with a short of length delivery, the batsman opens the face and pushes it to deep backward point
length delivery on off, the batsman plays it towards mid on, but Ashwin is quick to intercept it from midwicket
he bowls another length delivery on the stumps, the batsman tucks it away to deep backward square leg
length delivery on off stump, the batsman steers it to third man
bowls a slower length delivery outside off, the batsman clears his front leg out and drives it to wide mid off, Morris does well to dive and stop that
he bowls another short delivery, the batsman hooks it to fine leg for a single
short of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends off the back foot
attempts a short delivery, but this is down the leg side
he bowls a short of length delivery on off stump, Bisla pushes it to point
he bowls a short delivery that comes in to the batsman at 148 kph (if the gun is to be believed), Kallis goes for a pull, but ends up mistiming it just out of reach of midwicket
he bowls it full on the off stump, the batsman brings his bat down in time to block it out
he bowls a fuller delivery outside off, the batsman slices it to third man for a single
oh that is a big wicket! Macca's return to the side has been cut short by an innocuous length delivery outside off! He tried to punch it off the back foot but chops it on to his stumps
he tries to whip this back of length delivery, but he gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards gully and they take a single
short of length delivery and this is on the pads, Bisla pulls it through backward square leg

he moves outside leg stump, but the bowler bowls a slower delivery wide outside off. The batsman can only push it to mid-off and he calls for a quick single, but there are overthrows as no one was backing
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman stays back and tucks it to the right of mid on for a single
he bowls length on off, but the batsman is Macca, not Bisla. He comes forward and drives it on the up through cover beautifully
it is slightly short in length and Bisla is quick to pounce on it, slaps it through midwicket for yet another boundary
he bowls a fuller length delivery from wide of crease, Macca/Bazza drives it hard down the ground. The bowler gets a hand to it and slows it down
he bowls it full on the pads and goes for an appeal, but from that angle, was always going to be difficult
it's hitting the middle more often now! Another full delivery by the bowler, the batsman hits it through the line and slaps it over the bowler's head, it just drops short of the boundary
that is his best shot today! He gets a length delivery from wide of the crease and he flicks it in the air to the deep square leg boundary. One bounce and four
he moves outside leg stump and punches a back of length delivery through extra cover, not much power, just timing there
back of length delivery on the off stump, the batsman defends it to point off the back foot
he bowls a full yorker length delivery on the middle, the batsman blocks it out towards mid on and takes a single
he bowls a quick short delivery, Bisla tries to play an upper cut and gets beaten again
bowls a well disguised slower delivery on  a length, Bisla goes for an across the line hoick and misses, he is lucky that the ball misses the off stump too

is that a drop! the batsman moves outside leg stump and tries to cut a length delivery on off, but is beaten. Dhoni is not able to collect it cleanly and it's hard to tell if that hit any part of the bat
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to mid on off the back foot
another length delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to cover
he bowls a length delivery that the batsman defends off the front foot
the leg stump takes a beating! Gambhir tries to hoick a fullish delivery angling in to him at good pace, he misses and the ball takes the leg stump out.. Big strike
short of length delivery angling in, the batsman pulls it hard through midwicket for another boundary
bowls it short of length on the stumps, the batsman walks back and across to try and clip it to the leg side, gets hit on the thigh pad instead
he bowls it full outside off, Gambhir slices it over point and it goes one bounce to the boundary
he bowls short of length on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and guides it to third man
slightly on the pads, the batsman flicks it in front of square for what looked like a couple, but Gambhir sends Bisla back after a single
he bowls a length delivery that the batsman tries to drive on the up, gets beaten
he comes down the pitch and makes some room too, plays a cracking drive off a length delivery through extra cover..
bowls a short delivery on the stumps. Bisla moves to the leg side and tries to ramp it over short third man, but makes no contact
he bowls length delivery on off stump, the batsman gets right behind it and defends it to the leg side
beautifully driven down the ground off a full delivery on off stump! It was not a front foot drive, more of a remove-the-front-leg-and-slam drive
short of length delivery on off stump, Gambhir stands tall on his toes and cuts it, but straight to point
bowls a full toss down the leg side, the keeper does well to get behind that
he bowls a quick length delivery on off stump, the batsman dabs it towards point off the back foot
he waits in the crease and opens the face of the bat to run it down to third man for a single
he bowls a full delivery angling across the right-hander, beats the bat as the batsman plays down the wrong line
he hits the top of off stump as the batsman plays an ugly hoick and misses, the ball flies to the boundary and how much more unlucky can you get
length delivery on the middle and leg line, the batsman defends it to midwicket, but the bowler has overstepped
bowls a length delivery but down the leg side, it slips under Dhoni's gloves for five wides
